column1: Yandy Diaz leads the slate with a strong track record of consistency, hitting safely in 72% of games and showing a recent uptick at the plate. He benefits from the leadoff spot and a favorable platoon matchup against Framber Valdez. Jake McCarthy also offers reliability atop the order with a similar hit rate and a park boost, making him a solid secondary choice. CJ Abrams, Elly De La Cruz, and Ryan Jeffers round out the top options with steady volume and advantageous matchups.
